Bombay High Court Overturns TISS Professor's Forced Retirement

The Bombay High Court has quashed the compulsory retirement of a Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) professor. The professor's retirement was ordered following his alleged creation of an alumni WhatsApp group. The court found the compulsory retirement order to be arbitrary and set it aside. The specific details of the alumni WhatsApp group's content or the professor's alleged role were not detailed in the coverage.
